4. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. The supplied UPS system and batteries shall be brand new, unused, and factory-sealed. Refurbished, re paired, reconditioned, or previously opened products shall not be accepted. 2. A valid Manufacturer Authorization Form (MAF) specific to this tender shall be submitted along with the bid. 3. The bidder shall provide a minimum 2-year comprehensive onsite warranty for the UPS system and a 5- year warranty for the batteries from the date of installation. 4. The supplier shall attend UPS and battery-related complaints within 4 hours and rectify faults within 24 hours. If unresolved, an equivalent or higher-capacity standby UPS with battery backup shall be provided at no additional cost until restoration. A signed undertaking shall be submitted along with the bid. 5. Installation, transportation, unloading, testing, demonstration, and user training shall be carried out by qualified engineers at no additional cost to the purchaser. 6. The bidder shall submit a valid and updated UDYAM Registration Certificate issued by the Government of India. 7. The bidder must maintain a minimum GeM Seller Rating of 4.5 as on the bid submission deadline. 8. The bidder shall have successfully executed similar supply orders for Government Departments, PSUs, o r Autonomous Bodies during the last three years. Copies of relevant contracts shall be submitted. 9. The bidder shall furnish audited financial statements, including the Balance Sheet, Profit & Loss Account , and Auditor’s Report, along with the corresponding Income Tax Returns (ITRs) for FY 2022–23, 2023–24, 2024–25, and 2025–26. Provisional or unaudited statements shall not be accepted. 10. The bidder shall submit a duly signed self-declaration confirming that they have not been blacklisted o r debarred by any Central or State Government Department, PSU, or Government Agency during the prece ding five years. 11. No advance payment shall be made under any circumstances. 100% payment shall be released only a fter successful delivery, installation, commissioning, and submission of a valid GST invoice, after deducting the applicable buyback value of old/obsolete equipment. 12. The purchaser reserves the right to verify the authenticity of any document submitted by the bidder wi th the respective issuing authority or OEM at any stage of the tender process. 13. Submission of forged, fabricated, altered, or misleading documents shall result in bid rejection and ma y attract appropriate legal action by the purchaser. 14. The bidder shall submit an OEM-certified Technical Compliance Certificate confirming that the offered UPS system and batteries comply with all the technical specifications and requirements mentioned in the t ender document. .
